datasets.title: Iris measurements
datasets.notes: The canonical classification dataset: four continuous flower measurements and a three-level species label.

datasets.title: Old Faithful eruption lengths
datasets.notes: Two continuous measurements from 272 eruptions, useful for distribution fitting and summary statistics.

datasets.title: Plant growth by treatment
datasets.notes: One factor with three levels (ctrl, trt1, trt2) and a continuous weight outcome.

datasets.title: Plant growth, two groups wide
datasets.notes: Ten control and ten treated plants in two columns, the shape expected by the independent T-Test and TOST.

datasets.title: Tooth growth by supplement and dose
datasets.notes: A two-factor design (supplement x dose) with the numeric dose kept as a covariate in Dose_num.

datasets.title: Sleep gain, paired measurements
datasets.notes: Ten subjects measured under two conditions, reshaped wide so paired tests compare Extra_1 with Extra_2.

datasets.title: Matched binary outcomes
datasets.notes: Three paired 0/1 measurements on 60 subjects, for McNemar and Cochran Q.

datasets.title: Chick weight over time, wide
datasets.source: datasets::ChickWeight (R), complete cases and six time points
datasets.notes: 45 chicks with complete follow-up at six time points, split across four diets.

datasets.title: Motor Trend car road tests
datasets.notes: The classic 32-car dataset: continuous performance and design measures plus binary and count codes.

datasets.title: Low birth weight risk factors
datasets.notes: 189 births with a binary low-weight outcome and a mix of continuous and binary risk factors.

datasets.title: School absence counts
datasets.notes: 146 children with school absence counts; the factor versions are kept next to numeric dummy codes for count models.

datasets.title: Housing satisfaction, expanded
datasets.notes: Satisfaction (Low/Medium/High) with numeric ordered codes; the original Freq weights are expanded to one row per response.

datasets.title: Chick weight, longitudinal
datasets.notes: 96 repeated observations on eight chicks (two per diet), with a small enough Chick code to be a grouping variable.

datasets.title: US arrests by state
datasets.notes: Four standardised crime measures on 50 states, commonly used for PCA and factor analysis.

datasets.title: Employee attitude survey
datasets.notes: Seven survey items on 30 departments, useful for Cronbach's alpha and exploratory factor analysis.

datasets.title: Two correlated latent abilities
datasets.notes: Six indicators generated from two correlated factors, for CFA and a two-factor structural model.

datasets.title: Three latent response profiles
datasets.notes: Four categorical indicators drawn from three classes with distinct response probabilities.

datasets.title: Binary responses to six items
datasets.notes: Six dichotomous items with a range of difficulties, generated from a two-parameter logistic model.

datasets.title: Conjoint profiles with ratings
datasets.notes: Full factorial design of three attributes with a rating that follows additive part-worth utilities.

datasets.title: Agreement between raters and methods
datasets.notes: Synthetic paired ratings on a five-point scale plus two continuous methods; covers ICC, Bland-Altman and kappa.

datasets.title: Lung cancer survival
datasets.notes: 228 patients with censoring, a 0/1 Event column and complete-case covariates for Cox models.

datasets.title: Heart transplant, start-stop
datasets.notes: 172 patients in start-stop format, the shape required by time-dependent Cox; Age is the original centred value plus 48.

datasets.title: Air passengers, monthly
datasets.notes: 144 monthly observations from 1949 to 1960 with a stable 12-month seasonal pattern.

datasets.title: New York air quality
datasets.notes: 153 daily observations with genuine missing values in Ozone (37) and Solar_R (7).

datasets.title: Two-group resampling sample
datasets.source: datasets::PlantGrowth (R), ctrl and trt1 subset in long form
datasets.notes: The same ten control and ten treated plants as plantgrowth_wide, in long form for permutation and bootstrap inference.

datasets.title: Two independent groups with a binary outcome and event counts
datasets.notes: 120 subjects: Control has a lower success proportion and a lower event rate than Treatment.

datasets.title: Five categories with unequal observed frequencies
datasets.notes: 100 observations in five categories, designed to show a goodness-of-fit test against equal shares.

datasets.title: Instrumental-variables demo
datasets.notes: 220 observations with an endogenous regressor X, two excluded instruments and one exogenous control.

datasets.title: Balanced panel demo
datasets.notes: 30 entities observed for 10 periods, with a persistent entity effect and two time-varying predictors.

datasets.title: Tobit and Heckman selection demo
datasets.notes: 450 observations with a lower-censored wage for Tobit and a 0/1 selection indicator with the Kids exclusion restriction for Heckman.

datasets.title: Propensity-score demo
datasets.notes: 600 observations with a binary treatment assigned by a known propensity score and a continuous outcome.

datasets.title: Competing risks by cause
datasets.notes: 280 subjects with three competing causes and administrative censoring coded as zero.

datasets.title: Recurrent events in a clinical cohort
datasets.notes: 150 subjects with repeated events in start-stop format and a binary treatment.

datasets.title: Accelerated life test
datasets.source: Synthetic Weibull AFT, seeded with set.seed(20261106)
datasets.notes: 180 units tested at five stress levels, with temperature as a secondary covariate.

datasets.title: Reliability growth failures
datasets.source: Synthetic Crow–AMSAA process, seeded with set.seed(20261106)
datasets.notes: Twenty cumulative failure times from a repairable system with a decreasing failure rate.

datasets.title: Binary outcome in three strata
datasets.notes: Three strata of 100 rows each with a binary exposure and a binary outcome: the counts can be entered in the Mantel-Haenszel table.

datasets.title: Binary response across an ordered dose
datasets.notes: Four ordered dose levels with an increasing response proportion: the 4×2 counts feed the Cochran-Armitage trend test.

datasets.title: Two categorical variables with missing codes
datasets.notes: 160 rows with a binary treatment, a three-level severity and a numeric age; 12 treatment and 10 severity codes are missing for the categorical imputation.

datasets.title: Gage R&R crossed study
datasets.notes: 90 rows: 10 parts measured by 3 operators with 3 replicates; Measurement has a part effect around 1.0 and a repeatability SD around 0.35, Width is a second correlated characteristic for the T² chart.

datasets.title: Acceptance sampling lots
datasets.notes: 30 lots of 50 inspected units with about 4% defectives; the acceptance mode uses the plan parameters, the data document the historical inspection.

datasets.title: Two-factor response surface with a third factor
datasets.notes: 11 runs: a 2^3 factorial plus three centre points; Y follows a quadratic surface in A and B with a linear effect of C.

datasets.title: Bivariate VAR(2) with correlated innovations
datasets.notes: 200 observations of a stable bivariate VAR(2) with a 0.3 residual correlation; Granger causality runs from y1 to y2.

datasets.title: GARCH(1,1) returns
datasets.notes: 500 returns with conditional variance omega = 0.05, alpha = 0.10, beta = 0.85: clear volatility clustering.

datasets.title: Local trend and two-regime Markov series
datasets.notes: 300 observations: Local is a noisy local linear trend; Markov alternates a low-volatility regime around -1 and a high-volatility regime around 2.

datasets.title: Stratified cluster sample of income
datasets.notes: 120 rows in six strata with four clusters each; Income depends on age and stratum, Employed is a binary outcome.

datasets.title: Non-linear regression with interactions
datasets.notes: 160 rows: Y is a non-linear function of X1, X2 and the interaction X2*X3, plus Gaussian noise.

datasets.title: Three-topic short-text corpus
datasets.notes: 36 short documents generated from three vocabularies; Group records the generating topic.

datasets.title: Discrete choice experiment with price and quality
datasets.notes: 90 choice sets of three alternatives; the chosen alternative follows a utility with a negative price effect and a positive quality effect.

datasets.title: MaxDiff best-worst blocks
datasets.notes: 80 blocks of four items; each block marks one best and one worst item.

datasets.title: Nine studies with effect sizes and standard errors
datasets.notes: Nine studies with small positive effects and heterogeneous standard errors.

datasets.title: Score with age and a binary treatment
datasets.notes: 80 rows: Score increases with age and with the binary treatment, with Gaussian noise.

datasets.title: Regular grid with spatial autocorrelation
datasets.notes: 144 cells of a 12x12 grid; Crime follows a gradient plus spatially autocorrelated noise, Income is a predictor.
